what_is_new_vs_TEMP: TEMP judges each 1 s cell against 'clearly worthless' (black/titles/unrelated) with 2 context cells. E3 adds event structure: 2 s segments on a 24 s timeline window (12 TARGET segments, 1 CONTEXT segment each side, 2 anchors per segment = TEMP anchors, 448 px) with TEMP's own stage-1 summary; each segment gets a role MAIN/SETUP/RESULT (keep, restores TEMP-removed cells), IDLE/JUNK (drop), UNSURE (TEMP decision). Guard: > 50% dropped -> TEMP mask. No boundary search, no keep-rate target, no per-video policy.
